source: Offline evaluation by Ritvik on the training cluster. Transcribed from his summary of ~/SIH2026/outputs/stratified_test.json (per tile: stratified_test.csv) and outputs/holdout_vitl/log.jsonl (epoch 37 row). Replace with those files when committed.

gamus_test_strata.method: 800 GAMUS test tiles, one centre 518x518 crop each (the website's tiled path is about 5% better). Strata from each tile's own class labels: urban 15% or more building; forested 30% or more tree; sparse under 5% building and under 10% tree; the rest mixed. Unseen tiles from cities seen in training.

holdout_nyc.method: Same recipe retrained with New York removed from training (holdout_vitl), scored on New York. One checkpoint: best building MAE, epoch 37.

cop30_terrain_alone.method: Copernicus GLO-30 derived terrain vs swisstopo LiDAR, 10 scenes.
